releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 293: Private Locker Lock Off now asks for confirmation after the PIN is verified, without asking for the PIN twice. When Lock OFF is active, a Lock On Karein button is available inside the unlocked Locker so PIN protection can be restored. Saved encrypted entries remain preserved.
